releaseNotes: Added wildcard filtering to the explorer with auto-expanded parents and a match-count badge.
Added collapse-all and expand-all toggling plus arrow, Home, End, and Escape keyboard navigation in the explorer tree.
Added file and folder context menus in the explorer: mark reviewed, copy relative or full path, and reveal in the system file manager.
Added per-folder changed-file counts with review summaries in the explorer.
Added Cmd/Ctrl+N to start a review note and Cmd/Ctrl+K to ask the agent about the selected lines, with shortcut badges in the selection tools.
Fixed keyboard focus transfer into the explorer tree and repository search under the renderer build.
